title: Food as Soft Power: Taiwanese Gastrodiplomacy on Social Media and Algorithmic Suppression
reasoning: The paper focuses on the intersection of gastrodiplomacy, digital soft power, and political suppression on social media platforms. It analyzes engagement data related to Taiwanese cuisine and Instagram's algorithmic treatment of content mentioning Taiwan. The study does not contain a component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
